name: 10570 · Pleasantville, NY
findings: ZIP 10570 (Pleasantville) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10570 (Pleasantville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 arts and cultural organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
